title: CodeGrind DSA Practice Gets a Smarter Twist
summary: Highlighting CodeGrind's AI-assisted DSA practice and the latest UX polish, with a focus on real-time coding, problem filtering, and enhanced security features.
core_message: CodeGrind blends LeetCode-like challenges with an AI-assisted mentor, real-time code execution, and a refreshed user experience. Practice smarter with adaptive problem filtering, secure sign-in, and seamless progress tracking across District-style layers of the platform.
cta: Try a new AI-assisted problem now and compare your approach with the AI mentor in the CodeGrind editor.
visual_brief: Short 20–30s product walkthrough showing the CodeGrind editor in action: problem prompt, real-time code editor with syntax highlighting, AI assistant panel offering guidance, and a quick problem-filter demo. End with a call-to-action screen and CodeGrind logo.
